• **Launch Details:** Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the portal, aiming to facilitate better coordination and promote agri-investments.

questions.question: Sulphur-cleaning device in coal plants not necessary. What is the main purpose of Flu Gas Desulphurisation (FGD) units?

options.text: To remove fly ash from flue gases
To remove sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from flue gases
To increase the efficiency of coal combustion

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**To remove sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from flue gases**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sulphur-cleaning device in coal plants not necessary: Central scientific committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **high-powered committee** has recommended scrapping the **mandate** for Flu Gas Desulphurisation (**FGD**) units in all coal-fired **thermal power plants (TPP)**.

 
 
• 
 
Current **SO₂ levels** in ambient air are about **10-20 micrograms/m³**, well below India's **air quality norm** of 80.

 
 
• 
 
**Stack heights** and **climatic conditions** in India help disperse SO₂, reducing local air pollution risks.

 
 
• 
 
**Indian coal** has **low sulphur content**, and SO₂ levels near plants with and without FGD units show no significant difference.

 
 
• 
 
**FGD technology** removes sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from flue gases of **coal-based thermal power plants**.

 
 
• 
 
FGD units were mandated by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** in 2015, with deadlines extended up to **2027-2029** based on location and capacity.

 
 
• 
 
Flue gases pass through a **limestone slurry (CaCO₃)** scrubber, converting SO₂ to **calcium sulphite**, then to **gypsum** (calcium sulphate dihydrate).

 
 
• 
 
Before FGD, **Electrostatic Precipitators (ESPs)** and **Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR)** units remove **fly ash** and **NOx** respectively.

 
 
• 
 
FGD installation involves **high capital costs** and is **water intensive**.

questions.question: Where is India’s first Variable Speed Pumped Storage Plant (PSP) located?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s first variable speed pumped storage plant commences operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**THDC India Ltd.** operates India’s first **Variable Speed Pumped Storage Plant (PSP)**.

 
 
• 
 
The plant is located at **Tehri, Uttarakhand**.

 
 
• 
 
The first **250 MW unit** of the plant has achieved **Commercial Operation Declaration (COD)**.

 
 
• 
 
A **Pumped Storage Plant** pumps water from a **lower reservoir** to an **upper reservoir** during **off-peak hours** using surplus power.

 
 
• 
 
During **peak demand**, water is released from the upper reservoir to **generate electricity**.

 
 
• 
 
**Variable speed PSPs** provide **flexible and precise control** over pump-turbine operations.

 
 
• 
 
This flexibility helps the plant respond quickly to **grid demand fluctuations** and **renewable energy intermittency**.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recent inclusion of Ramsar Wetland Sites in India: (**as of June 2025**)

1. India has added two new wetlands—Khichan (Phalodi) and Menar (Udaipur), both in Rajasthan, raising the country’s total Ramsar sites to 91.

2. India holds the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

Which of the above statements is/are ***CORRECT***?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 2 only.

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct**: The two most recently designated Ramsar sites in India are Khichan (Phalodi) and Menar (Udaipur)** **in **Rajasthan (As of June 2025).**
 
• **Statement 2 is correct** as India holds the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia and ranks third globally, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **In News__**

__
 
• The two most recently designated Ramsar sites in India are Gokul Jalashay and Udaipur Jheel in Bihar, both added in September 2025. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khichan (Phalodi):** A critical site for avian biodiversity, particularly for migratory Demoiselle cranes.
 
• **Menar (Udaipur):** Known for its community-led bird conservation efforts, often referred to as "Bird Village."
 
• **Ramsar Sites in India:** India now has the highest number of Ramsar sites in Asia, demonstrating its strong commitment to wetland conservation and biodiversity protection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramsar Convention:** An international treaty adopted in 1971 to conserve and wisely use wetlands. India became a party to this convention in 1982.
 
• **Global Ranking:** India ranks third globally in terms of Ramsar sites, after the United Kingdom and Mexico.

questions.question: How many Ramsar Sites does India now have in total? (As of June 2025)
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**91**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Two more Ramsar wetland sites in India, taking the total to 91

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
Recent additions to the list in September 2025 include **Gokul Reservoir **and **Udaipur Lake** in Bihar, bringing the total number of sites to 96.

 
 
• 
 
Two new wetlands in Rajasthan, **Khichan (Phalodi)** and **Menar (Udaipur)** declared as **Ramsar Sites**.

 
 
• 
 
Total **Ramsar Sites in India** now: **98 **– **highest in Asia**.

 
 
• 
 
Rajasthan now has **4 Ramsar Sites**:

 
 
• 
 
**Sambhar Salt Lake**

 
 
• 
 
**Keoladeo National Park**

 
 
• 
 
**Khichan**

 
 
• 
 
**Menar**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Timeline**:

 
 
• 
 
J**une 2025 (91 Sites)**: Khichan Wetland and Menar Wetland Complex (Rajasthan) added on World Environment Day. 

 
 
• 
 
**September 2025 (93 Sites)**: Gokul Jalashay and Udaipur Jheel (Bihar) officially designated. 

 
 
• 
 
**October 2025 (94 Sites)**: Gogabeel Lake (Bihar) recognized as the 94th site.

 
 
• 
 
**December 2025 (96 Sites)**: Siliserh Lake (Rajasthan) and Kopra Jalashay (Chhattisgarh) added; Kopra Jalashay is Chhattisgarh's first Ramsar site. 

 
 
• 
 
**January 30, 2026 (98 Sites)**: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Uttar Pradesh) and Chhari-Dhand (Gujarat) were designated ahead of World Wetlands Day 2026.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Ramsar Convention** was adopted in **1971** in **Ramsar, Iran**.

 
 
• 
 
It aims for **conservation and wise use** of **wetlands globally**.

 
 
• 
 
**India joined Ramsar Convention** in **1982**.

questions.question: Which ministry collaborated with Invest India to develop the Ayush Nivesh Saarthi portal?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ministry of Ayush**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India launches ‘Ayush Nivesh Saarthi’ portal to boost investment in traditional medicine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The Government of India launched the **Ayush Nivesh Saarthi** portal at Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi.

 
 
• 
 
The portal was jointly launched by Union Ministers **Piyush Goyal** (Commerce & Industry) and **Prataprao Jadhav** (State Minister, Ayush).

 
 
• 
 
Developed by the **Ministry of Ayush** in collaboration with **Invest India**, it is an investor-centric digital platform.

 
 
• 
 
It integrates policy frameworks, incentives, investment-ready projects, and real-time facilitation in one interface.

 
 
• 
 
The aim is to position India as a **global hub for traditional medicine and wellness** and attract domestic and foreign investments.

 
 
• 
 
**100% FDI** is allowed in the Ayush sector through the automatic route.

 
 
• 
 
The sector leverages India’s heritage of **8,000+ medicinal plant species** and a globally trusted wellness tradition.

 
 
• 
 
The portal is designed to empower investors with transparent policy guidance and real-time data.

questions.question: Which Indian state is set to get its first nuclear power plant under the National Nuclear Energy Mission?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bihar to get its first nuclear power plant as part of national SMR rollout.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Bihar** will soon host its **first nuclear power plant**, under the **National Nuclear Energy Mission**.

 
 
• 
 
It is among the **first six states** selected for this initiative.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to **diversify India’s energy mix** and boost **regional energy security**.

 
 
• 
 
The project will involve **advanced technologies** like **Small Modular Reactors (SMRs)**.

 
 
• 
 
**SMRs** are compact nuclear reactors with up to **300 MW** capacity—about **one-third** of traditional nuclear plants.

 
 
• 
 
A separate **1,000 MW battery storage project** has also been approved in **Bihar**.

 
 
• 
 
The government will provide **₹18 lakh per MW** as **viability gap funding** for the battery storage project.

 
 
• 
 
Announced in the Union Budget 2025-26 with a Rs 20,000 crore allocation, the Nuclear Energy Mission aims at expanding clean and reliable nuclear power across the country and strengthen regional energy security.

questions.question: Who won the Women’s Singles title at the French Open 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Coco Gauff**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Coco Gauff Clinches First French Open Title, Defeats Sabalenka in Grand Slam Final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Coco Gauff**, a **21-year-old American**, won the **2025 French Open Women’s Singles title**.

 
 
• 
 
She defeated **world number one Aryna Sabalenka** in the final: **6-7(5), 6-2, 6-4**.

 
 
• 
 
This is Gauff’s **first French Open title** and **second Grand Slam victory** (after the **2023 US Open**).

 
 
• 
 
She became the **first American woman** to win the **French Open singles title** since **Serena Williams in 2015**.

 
 
• 
 
Gauff is the **youngest American** to win the title since **Serena in 2002**.

 
 
• 
 
This was the **first Grand Slam final on clay** for **Sabalenka**, and her **third consecutive Slam final** overall.

 
 
• 
 
It was also the **first meeting of world number 1 and 2** in a Grand Slam final since the **2018 Australian Open**.

 
 
• 
 
Gauff now has Slam titles on **both hard and clay courts**.
